name: TWCDI Overview
description: Query all 20 TWCDI data classes from TW Core
cql:
library TWCDIOverview version '1.0.0'
using FHIR version '4.0.1'
include FHIRHelpers version '4.0.1' called FHIRHelpers

// Taiwan Core Data for Interoperability - All 20 Data Classes

codesystem "ObservationCategory": 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category'
code "vital-signs": 'vital-signs' from "ObservationCategory"
code "laboratory": 'laboratory' from "ObservationCategory"

context Patient

// 1. Demographics
define "Patient Info":
  Patient

// 2. Encounters
define "All Encounters":
  [Encounter] E

// 3. Conditions / Diagnoses
define "All Conditions":
  [Condition] C

// 4. Vital Signs
define "Vital Signs":
  [Observation] O
    where exists (O.category Cat where Cat ~ "vital-signs")
      and O.status.value in { 'final', 'amended', 'corrected' }

// 5. Laboratory Results
define "Lab Results":
  [Observation] O
    where exists (O.category Cat where Cat ~ "laboratory")
      and O.status.value in { 'final', 'amended', 'corrected' }

// 6. Medication Requests
define "Medication Orders":
  [MedicationRequest] M

// 7. Medication Statements
define "Medication Usage":
  [MedicationStatement] M

// 8. Medications
define "Medications":
  [Medication]

// 9. Procedures
define "All Procedures":
  [Procedure] P

// 10. Diagnostic Reports
define "Diagnostic Reports":
  [DiagnosticReport] D

// 11. Allergies
define "Allergies":
  [AllergyIntolerance] A

// 12. Immunizations
define "Immunizations":
  [Immunization] I
    where I.status.value = 'completed'

// 13-20. Other Resources
define "Organizations":
  [Organization]

define "Practitioners":
  [Practitioner]

define "Imaging Studies":
  [ImagingStudy]

define "Locations":
  [Location]

define "Compositions":
  [Composition]

define "Document References":
  [DocumentReference]

name: TWCDI Vital Signs
description: Blood pressure, heart rate, temperature, SpO2, weight, height, BMI
cql:
library TWCDIVitalSigns version '1.0.0'
using FHIR version '4.0.1'
include FHIRHelpers version '4.0.1' called FHIRHelpers

// TW Core Vital Signs Queries
codesystem "LOINC": 'http://loinc.org'

code "BP Code": '85354-9' from "LOINC" display 'Blood Pressure Panel'
code "HR Code": '8867-4' from "LOINC" display 'Heart Rate'
code "Temp Code": '8310-5' from "LOINC" display 'Body Temperature'
code "RR Code": '9279-1' from "LOINC" display 'Respiratory Rate'
code "SpO2 Code": '2708-6' from "LOINC" display 'Oxygen Saturation'
code "Weight Code": '29463-7' from "LOINC" display 'Body Weight'
code "Height Code": '8302-2' from "LOINC" display 'Body Height'
code "BMI Code": '39156-5' from "LOINC" display 'BMI'

context Patient

define "Blood Pressure Readings":
  [Observation: "BP Code"] O
    where O.status.value in { 'final', 'amended', 'corrected' }

define "Most Recent BP":
  Last("Blood Pressure Readings")

define "Heart Rate":
  [Observation: "HR Code"] O
    where O.status.value in { 'final', 'amended', 'corrected' }

define "Body Temperature":
  [Observation: "Temp Code"] O
    where O.status.value in { 'final', 'amended', 'corrected' }

define "Respiratory Rate":
  [Observation: "RR Code"] O
    where O.status.value in { 'final', 'amended', 'corrected' }

define "SpO2":
  [Observation: "SpO2 Code"] O
    where O.status.value in { 'final', 'amended', 'corrected' }

define "Body Weight":
  [Observation: "Weight Code"] O
    where O.status.value in { 'final', 'amended', 'corrected' }

define "Body Height":
  [Observation: "Height Code"] O
    where O.status.value in { 'final', 'amended', 'corrected' }

define "BMI":
  [Observation: "BMI Code"] O
    where O.status.value in { 'final', 'amended', 'corrected' }

name: TWCDI Medications
description: Active medications, prescriptions, and medication statements
cql:
library TWCDIMedications version '1.0.0'
using FHIR version '4.0.1'
include FHIRHelpers version '4.0.1' called FHIRHelpers

// TW Core Medication Queries
// Uses NHI Medication code system for Taiwan drug codes
codesystem "NHI Medication": 'https://twcore.mohw.gov.tw/ig/twcore/CodeSystem/medication-nhi-tw'

context Patient

define "Active Medication Orders":
  [MedicationRequest] M
    where M.status.value = 'active'
      and M.intent.value = 'order'

define "All Medication Orders":
  [MedicationRequest] M

define "Completed Medication Orders":
  [MedicationRequest] M
    where M.status.value = 'completed'

define "Medication Statements":
  [MedicationStatement] M

define "Active Medication Statements":
  [MedicationStatement] M
    where M.status.value = 'active'

define "Medication Resources":
  [Medication]

define "Has Active Medications":
  exists("Active Medication Orders")

define "Active Medication Count":
  Count("Active Medication Orders")

name: TWCDI Conditions
description: Active conditions, diagnoses, and problem list
cql:
library TWCDIConditions version '1.0.0'
using FHIR version '4.0.1'
include FHIRHelpers version '4.0.1' called FHIRHelpers

// TW Core Condition / Diagnosis Queries
// Taiwan uses ICD-10-CM-TW for diagnoses
codesystem "ICD-10-CM-TW": 'https://twcore.mohw.gov.tw/ig/twcore/CodeSystem/icd-10-cm-2023-tw'
codesystem "ConditionClinicalStatus": 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-clinical'
codesystem "ConditionVerStatus": 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-ver-status'
codesystem "ConditionCategory": 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-category'

code "active": 'active' from "ConditionClinicalStatus"
code "resolved": 'resolved' from "ConditionClinicalStatus"
code "confirmed": 'confirmed' from "ConditionVerStatus"
code "problem-list-item": 'problem-list-item' from "ConditionCategory"
code "encounter-diagnosis": 'encounter-diagnosis' from "ConditionCategory"

context Patient

define "All Conditions":
  [Condition] C

define "Active Conditions":
  [Condition] C
    where C.clinicalStatus ~ "active"

define "Confirmed Conditions":
  [Condition] C
    where C.verificationStatus ~ "confirmed"

define "Problem List":
  [Condition] C
    where exists (C.category Cat where Cat ~ "problem-list-item")
      and C.clinicalStatus ~ "active"

define "Encounter Diagnoses":
  [Condition] C
    where exists (C.category Cat where Cat ~ "encounter-diagnosis")

define "Resolved Conditions":
  [Condition] C
    where C.clinicalStatus ~ "resolved"

define "Active Condition Count":
  Count("Active Conditions")

name: TWCDI Encounters
cql:
library TWCDIEncounters version '1.0.0'
using FHIR version '4.0.1'
include FHIRHelpers version '4.0.1' called FHIRHelpers

// TW Core Encounter Queries
codesystem "ActCode": 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-ActCode'

code "AMB": 'AMB' from "ActCode" display 'ambulatory'
code "IMP": 'IMP' from "ActCode" display 'inpatient encounter'
code "EMER": 'EMER' from "ActCode" display 'emergency'

context Patient

define "All Encounters":
  [Encounter] E

define "Finished Encounters":
  [Encounter] E
    where E.status.value = 'finished'

define "In Progress Encounters":
  [Encounter] E
    where E.status.value = 'in-progress'

define "Ambulatory Encounters":
  [Encounter] E
    where E.class ~ "AMB"

define "Inpatient Encounters":
  [Encounter] E
    where E.class ~ "IMP"

define "Emergency Encounters":
  [Encounter] E
    where E.class ~ "EMER"

define "Most Recent Encounter":
  Last([Encounter] E where E.status.value = 'finished')

define "Encounter Count":
  Count("Finished Encounters")

name: TWCDI Allergies
cql:
library TWCDIAllergies version '1.0.0'
using FHIR version '4.0.1'
include FHIRHelpers version '4.0.1' called FHIRHelpers

// TW Core Allergy / Intolerance Queries
codesystem "AllergyClinicalStatus": 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-clinical'

code "active": 'active' from "AllergyClinicalStatus"

context Patient

define "All Allergies":
  [AllergyIntolerance] A

define "Active Allergies":
  [AllergyIntolerance] A
    where A.clinicalStatus ~ "active"

define "Medication Allergies":
  [AllergyIntolerance] A
    where exists (A.category Cat where Cat.value = 'medication')
      and A.clinicalStatus ~ "active"

define "Food Allergies":
  [AllergyIntolerance] A
    where exists (A.category Cat where Cat.value = 'food')
      and A.clinicalStatus ~ "active"

define "High Criticality Allergies":
  [AllergyIntolerance] A
    where A.criticality.value = 'high'
      and A.clinicalStatus ~ "active"

define "Has Active Allergies":
  exists("Active Allergies")

define "Active Allergy Count":
  Count("Active Allergies")

name: TWCDI Immunizations
cql:
library TWCDIImmunizations version '1.0.0'
using FHIR version '4.0.1'
include FHIRHelpers version '4.0.1' called FHIRHelpers

// TW Core Immunization Queries
context Patient

define "All Immunizations":
  [Immunization] I

define "Completed Immunizations":
  [Immunization] I
    where I.status.value = 'completed'

define "Not Done Immunizations":
  [Immunization] I
    where I.status.value = 'not-done'

define "Most Recent Completed Immunization":
  Last([Immunization] I where I.status.value = 'completed')

define "Immunization Count":
  Count("Completed Immunizations")

define "Has Immunizations":
  exists("Completed Immunizations")
